# Anycode v0.1.2

Anycode v0.1.2 introduces token-based access protection for remote and networked workspaces, fixes editor selection replacement on paste/input, and adds an interactive live Markdown preview.

## Security & Authentication

- Added `-t, --token <TOKEN>` CLI option and `ANYCODE_TOKEN` environment variable to require access token authentication for the web interface and WebSocket connections.
- Automatically rejects unauthenticated requests with `401 Unauthorized` when a token is configured.
- Seamless authentication via `?token=...` with secure `HttpOnly` and `SameSite=Lax` session cookies.

## Editor

- Fixed selection replacement behavior: pasting or typing with an active selection now reliably replaces the selected range.

## Markdown

- Added interactive live Markdown preview panel with syntax-highlighted code blocks, local image rendering, and scroll position persistence.

**Full comparison:** `v0.1.1...v0.1.2`
